scheme_name: Marriage Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: The applicant must be a woman worker employed in a factory or organization in Gujarat.
The Labour Welfare Fund for the concerned woman worker must be paid by the organization at the office.
The Labour Welfare Fund for the last one year must be mandatorily filled by the employer.
The application must be submitted within one year from the date of marriage.
There must be a gap of one year between the date of employment and the date of marriage.
benefits_summary: Female workers receive a financial assistance of ₹11,000 after marriage.
